[in reality nowadays i pray regular namaz and has avoided even t.v. i pray darrod also so what does it mean Answer ID: 14631 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1306/1063=D/1430) The dream indicates that the people in general to day have limited the world life to sports and entertainment and negligence in the objectives of life is common. By showing the name of Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) in dream you were communicated that real success lies in attaching oneself with him by following his Shariah in all stages and occasions of life with emphasis on his lifestyle and love towards him. Feeling the greatness of the name of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) signifies the importance of the above-mentioned matters for you, otherwise there is a group which is out to make fun of Shariah and Shariah-maker. May Allah protect us! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
